title: 茶水间英文 - 10月23日 | Meta烧钱暴跌、SpaceX搞电信、世界大赛开打
description:
Meta told investors it must raise hundreds of billions of dollars to fund its AI plans — and the stock nosedived, wiping out over a hundred billion dollars in a single day. Alex and Jordan also dig into SpaceX's plan to become your phone company, plus World Series Game One tonight, where a first-time champion is guaranteed.

Meta 宣布未来几年要为 AI 计划募资数千亿美元，股价应声暴跌、单日蒸发超千亿美元，华尔街开始担心整个 AI 热潮是借钱堆出来的。两人还聊了 SpaceX 计划进军美国移动通信市场、挑战三大运营商，以及今晚开打的世界大赛——无论谁赢，都是队史首冠。

Words to steal 生词本：
- throw the baby out with the bathwater — 因噎废食；好的坏的一起扔掉
- wipe out — 蒸发；一扫而空
- pass the hat — 募捐；向大家讨钱
- recurring revenue — 持续性收入
- wireless carrier — 无线运营商
- home-field advantage — 主场优势
- Canadian tuxedo — 全套牛仔装（戏称）
